title: Kafka Consumer-Group Design Plan
description: A structured plan for a Kafka consumer group — delivery guarantee, commit mode, assignment strategy, poll budget, DLQ pattern — so this skill's Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/kafka_consumer_group_design_audit.mjs.

deliveryGuarantee.description: The required delivery semantic per the Kafka design docs' three commit patterns.

autoCommit.description: True if enable.auto.commit=true. Must be false for at-least-once and exactly-once designs.

processingIdempotent.description: True if the sink is idempotent (duplicates on reprocess are harmless). Required for at-least-once.

assignmentStrategy.description: The partition assignment strategy. cooperative-sticky is the classic-protocol default choice; kip848-server-side under group.protocol=consumer.

groupProtocol.description: The rebalance protocol: classic (eager/cooperative client-side) or consumer (KIP-848 next-gen, Kafka 4.0+).

usesClientSideAssignor.description: True if the design depends on a custom client-side assignor. Not supported under KIP-848 as of Kafka 4.0 (KAFKA-18327).

perRecordProcessingMs.description: Measured worst-case per-record processing time in milliseconds.

maxPollIntervalMs.description: max.poll.interval.ms (default 300000). The worst-case batch must clear this with 50%+ headroom.

transactionalIdStrategy.description: How transactional.id is derived for exactly-once designs. Must be stable-per-instance.

isolationLevelReadCommitted.description: True if consumers of the output topics set isolation.level=read_committed. Required for exactly-once.

sendOffsetsToTransaction.description: True if offsets are committed via producer.sendOffsetsToTransaction inside the output transaction. Required for exactly-once.

crossSystemSideEffects.description: True if processing also writes to a non-Kafka system (DB, external API). Kafka transactions do not cover that boundary.

dlqPattern.description: The poison-message strategy, per Confluent's four error-handling patterns.

perEntityOrderingRequired.description: True if events for the same key must be processed in order even when some detour through the error path.

commitsInOnPartitionsRevoked.description: True if a ConsumerRebalanceListener commits current offsets in onPartitionsRevoked.
